title.zh: 最短路 · 从起点像洪水一样漫开
title.en: Shortest Path · Flooding Out From the Start

desc.zh: 迪杰斯特拉算法每次“确认”离起点最近的那个点：最短路径是被“漫到”的顺序逼出来的；也看它怎样在带权地图上绕开泥地，以及什么时候会出错。
desc.en: Dijkstra’s algorithm “settles” the nearest node at a time: the shortest paths are forced out by the order in which the flood reaches things; see how it detours around mud on a weighted map and when it breaks.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
